([[Saly, Senegal]]) | career_start = 2022 | years1 = [[2022 BAL season|2022]] | team1 = →[[FAP Basketball|FAP]] | years2 = [[2023 BAL season|2023]] | team2 = →[[REG BBC|REG]] | highlights = * [[Nike Hoop Summit]] (2024) }} '''Ulrich Kamka Chomche''' (born 30 December 2005) is a Cameroonian professional [[basketball]] player. At 6 ft 10 in (2.08 m), he plays the [[Center (basketball)|center]] and [[power forward]] positions. A member of the [[NBA Academy Africa]], Chomche has been labeled by ''[[ESPN]]'' as the best Cameroonian prospect of his generation, and the best since [[Joel Embiid]].{{Cite web |date=17 March 2023 |title=Cameroon's best prospect since Embiid? Ulrich Chomche is Him |url=https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/35878211/cameroon-best-prospect-joel-embiid-wonderkid-ulrich-chomche-him |access-date=27 March 2023 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ==Early life== Chomche was born in [[Bafang]], a place in the [[West Region (Cameroon)|West Province]] of Cameroon, and picked up basketball at age 11 due to peer pressure because he was the tallest kid in his neighborhood. One year later, he joined the [[NBA Academy Africa]] in [[Saly]], [[Senegal]] and started studying English. Chomche played at the 2022 [[Basketball Without Borders]] camp in [[Cairo]] and was named the Defensive MVP among boys at the camp.{{Cite web |title=Egyptian Elalfy and Darlan of CAF named BWB Africa camp MVPs |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/news/egyptian-elalfy-and-darlan-of-caf-named-bwb-africa-camp-mvps |access-date=27 March 2023 |website=FIBA.basketball |language=en}} ==Professional career== Chomche made his debut in the [[Basketball Africa League]] (BAL) at age 16 in 2022, as he played for Cameroonian club [[FAP Basketball|FAP]] under the BAL Elevate program. This program allocated players from the [[NBA Academy Africa]] to professional teams. He averaged 2.1 points and 3.7 rebounds in 11.3 minutes per game,{{Cite web |title=Ulurich Chomche Player Profile, REG - RealGM |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Ulurich-Chomche/Summary/155584 |access-date=27 March 2023 |website=basketball.realgm.com}} and was part of FAP's run to the fourth place.{{Cite web |date=15 August 2022 |title=Cameroon: FAP Basketballer Ulrich Chomche Writing His Story One Step At A Time - PAN AFRICAN VISIONS |url=https://panafricanvisions.com/2022/08/cameroon-fap-basketballer-ulrich-chomche-writing-his-story-one-step-at-a-time/ |access-date=27 March 2023 |language=en-US}} On 16 April, he grabbed a career-high seven rebounds against [[Petro de Luanda (basketball)|Petro de Luanda]]. The next year, in [[2023 BAL season|2023]], Chomche was drafted by the Rwandan team [[REG BBC|REG]] to play in his second consecutive BAL season. During the tournament, he received praise from former NBA player [[Joakim Noah]]. In March 2024, Chomche was drafted by Rwandan club [[APR BBC|APR]] for the [[2024 BAL season]].{{Cite web |date=4 March 2024 |title=Top NBA Draft prospects land on new BAL teams |url=https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/39651148/top-nba-draft-prospects-ulrich-chomche-khaman-maluach-land-bal-teams-2024-season |access-date=15 March 2024 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} On 15 April 2024, Chomche declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]].{{Cite web |date=16 April 2024 |title=NBA Academy Africa center Ulrich Chomche declares for 2024 NBA draft |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/nba-academy-africa-center-ulrich-034043975.html |access-date=16 April 2024 |website=Yahoo Sports |language=en-US}} ==National team career== In February 2023, Chomche was first selected for [[Cameroon men's national basketball team|Cameroon senior national team]] for the [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification|2023 World Cup qualifiers]].{{Cite web |title=Final rosters confirmed ahead of Window 6 of the 2023 African Qualifiers |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2023/african-qualifiers/news/final-rosters-confirmed-ahead-of-window-6-of-the-2023-african-qualifiers |access-date=27 March 2023 |website=FIBA.basketball |language=en}} He made his debut on 24 February 2023 in [[Alexandria]], playing eight minutes in the 85–56 win over [[DR Congo men's national basketball team|DR Congo]].{{Cite web |title=Cameroon v Congo DR boxscore - FIBA Basketball World Cup 2023 African Qualifiers - 24 February |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2023/african-qualifiers/game/2402/Cameroon-Congo-DR |access-date=27 March 2023 |website=FIBA.basketball |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=FIBA Basketball World Cup 2023 African Qualifiers |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2023/african-qualifiers/player/Ulrich-Kamka-Chomche |access-date=27 March 2023 |website=FIBA.basketball |language=en}} ==Career statistics== {{BAL player statistics legend}} ===BAL=== {{BAL player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2022 BAL season|2022]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[FAP Basketball|FAP]] | '''7''' || '''1''' || 11.3 || .304 || '''.200''' || – || 3.7 || .1 || .3 || '''1.6''' || 2.1 |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2023 BAL season|2023]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[REG BBC|REG]] | 6 || 0 || '''19.0''' || '''.345''' || .125 || '''.545''' || '''4.8''' || '''.7''' || '''1.0''' || 1.0 || '''4.5''' {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Chomche, Ulrich}} [[Category:2005 births]] [[Category:REG BBC players]] [[Category:FAP Basketball players]] [[Category:Cameroonian men's basketball players]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[Category:NBA Academy Africa players]] [[Category:People from West Region (Cameroon)]] [[Category:Power forwards]]
